description: This file is the controller for managing marketplace tasks within the Opencart admin panel. It provides functionalities such as listing tasks, starting/stopping tasks, changing their statuses, viewing logs, and deleting tasks.

classes.name: Task
classes.description: Controller class for marketplace task management in Opencart admin.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main entry point for displaying the task management interface, preparing data for the view.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Handles AJAX request to retrieve the list of tasks.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Retrieves filtered list of tasks with pagination and returns HTML view.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Initiates starting of background tasks via CLI commands.

methods.name: cli
methods.description: Processes task execution sequentially from the queue in CLI context.

methods.name: pause
methods.description: Changes status of pending tasks to paused.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Clears all tasks from the task list/storage.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes selected tasks based on user request.

methods.name: status
methods.description: Updates the status of selected tasks.

methods.name: getLog
methods.description: Retrieves paginated log entries and renders log view.
